items.text: THE UNION PARLIAMENT, PRESIDENT AND JUDICIARY
bold: THE UNION PARLIAMENT, PRESIDENT AND JUDICIARY

items.text: Class 8 Civics | Sample notes
LOK SABHA – Lower House of Parliament
bold: LOK SABHA – Lower House of Parliament

items.text: Members are directly elected by the people.
items.topic: LOK SABHA – Lower House of Parliament

items.text: Term: 5 years, unless dissolved earlier.
items.topic: LOK SABHA – Lower House of Parliament

items.text: Presiding officer: the Speaker.
items.topic: LOK SABHA – Lower House of Parliament

items.text: A member must be at least 25 years old.
items.topic: LOK SABHA – Lower House of Parliament

items.text: RAJYA SABHA – Upper House of Parliament
bold: RAJYA SABHA – Upper House of Parliament

items.text: Members are elected by the members of the State Legislative Assemblies.
items.topic: RAJYA SABHA – Upper House of Parliament

items.text: It is a permanent house and cannot be dissolved.
items.topic: RAJYA SABHA – Upper House of Parliament

items.text: A member's term is 6 years; one-third of the members retire every 2 years.
items.topic: RAJYA SABHA – Upper House of Parliament

items.text: Presiding officer: the Vice-President of India.
items.topic: RAJYA SABHA – Upper House of Parliament

items.text: A member must be at least 30 years old.
items.topic: RAJYA SABHA – Upper House of Parliament

items.text: THE PRESIDENT – Head of the State
bold: THE PRESIDENT – Head of the State

items.text: Elected by an electoral college of elected members of Parliament and the State Legislative Assemblies.
items.topic: THE PRESIDENT – Head of the State

items.text: Term: 5 years.
items.topic: THE PRESIDENT – Head of the State

items.text: Must be at least 35 years old.
items.topic: THE PRESIDENT – Head of the State

items.text: Is the Supreme Commander of the armed forces.
items.topic: THE PRESIDENT – Head of the State

items.text: SUPREME COURT – Highest court of India
bold: SUPREME COURT – Highest court of India

items.text: It is located in New Delhi.
items.topic: SUPREME COURT – Highest court of India

items.text: Its judges are appointed by the President.
items.topic: SUPREME COURT – Highest court of India

items.text: Judges retire at the age of 65.
items.topic: SUPREME COURT – Highest court of India

items.text: It protects the Fundamental Rights of citizens.
items.topic: SUPREME COURT – Highest court of India

items.text: It is called the guardian of the Constitution.
items.topic: SUPREME COURT – Highest court of India

items.text: QUICK COMPARISON
Lok Sabha = people's house (5 years, Speaker)
Rajya Sabha = permanent house (6 years, Vice-President)
The President = head of the State (5 years, age 35)
Supreme Court = guardian of the Constitution (retire at 65)
